sub_graphs.title: EIP-2831: Transaction Speed-Up Event Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the flow when a user speeds up a pending transaction by increasing gas price

nodes.label: Original Transaction Pending
nodes.description: Transaction submitted and waiting in mempool, not yet included in block

nodes.label: User Initiates Speed-Up
nodes.description: User requests to speed up transaction through wallet interface

nodes.label: Speed-Up Requested
nodes.description: Wallet received request to increase gas price

nodes.label: Validate Speed-Up Invariants
nodes.description: Check same nonce, recipient, value, and data; verify 10% gas increase

nodes.label: Speed-Up Invariants Valid
nodes.description: New transaction meets all speed-up requirements

nodes.label: Submit Replacement Transaction
nodes.description: Broadcast new transaction with higher gas price

nodes.label: Replacement Transaction Submitted
nodes.description: New transaction sent to network

nodes.label: Emit tx_speedup Event
nodes.description: Provider emits event with oldTx, newTx, nonce, from

nodes.label: DApp Notified of Speed-Up
nodes.description: Application received tx_speedup event with transaction details

external_entities.name: Wallet User
external_entities.description: User who initiated the transaction and wants faster confirmation

external_entities.name: DApp Event Listener
external_entities.description: Application listening for transaction replacement events

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2831: Transaction Cancellation Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition when a user cancels a pending transaction

nodes.label: Pending Transaction Cancellable
nodes.description: Original transaction in mempool, can still be cancelled

nodes.label: User Requests Cancellation
nodes.description: User wants to void the pending transaction

nodes.label: Cancellation Requested
nodes.description: Wallet received cancel request

nodes.label: Construct Cancel Transaction
nodes.description: Create tx with same nonce, from=to, value=0, data=empty

nodes.label: Cancel Transaction Constructed
nodes.description: Self-send transaction ready with higher gas

nodes.label: Submit Cancel Transaction
nodes.description: Broadcast cancel transaction to network

nodes.label: Cancel Transaction Submitted
nodes.description: Cancel transaction in mempool competing with original

nodes.label: Emit tx_cancel Event
nodes.description: Provider emits cancellation event

nodes.label: DApp Notified of Cancellation
nodes.description: Application knows original transaction may be cancelled

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2831: Generic Transaction Replacement
sub_graphs.description: Models complete transaction substitution where only nonce must match

nodes.label: Original Transaction Pending
nodes.description: First transaction waiting in mempool

nodes.label: User Creates Replacement
nodes.description: User constructs entirely different transaction with same nonce

nodes.label: Replacement Transaction Created
nodes.description: New transaction with same nonce, different recipient/value/data

nodes.label: Validate Nonce Match
nodes.description: Verify only that nonces match (no other invariants)

nodes.label: Nonce Match Validated
nodes.description: Replacement has valid matching nonce

nodes.label: Submit Generic Replacement
nodes.description: Broadcast replacement transaction

nodes.label: Replacement Transaction Submitted
nodes.description: New transaction competing with original

nodes.label: Emit tx_replacement Event
nodes.description: Provider emits generic replacement event

nodes.label: DApp Notified of Replacement
nodes.description: Application knows transaction was completely replaced

external_entities.name: Wallet User
external_entities.description: User replacing pending transaction with entirely different one

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2831: Transaction Replacement Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules that distinguish different replacement types

nodes.label: Replacement Transaction Received
nodes.description: Provider received a transaction that may replace existing one

nodes.label: Check If Nonce Already Used
nodes.description: Determine if pending tx exists with same nonce

nodes.label: No Existing Transaction
nodes.description: No pending tx with this nonce, treat as new tx

nodes.label: Existing Transaction Found
nodes.description: Pending transaction exists with matching nonce

nodes.label: Compare Transaction Fields
nodes.description: Compare recipient, value, data between old and new

nodes.label: Same Recipient/Value/Data
nodes.description: All fields match except gas price - this is speed-up

nodes.label: Self-Send with Zero Value
nodes.description: To=From, value=0, data=empty - this is cancel

nodes.label: Different Transaction Fields
nodes.description: Fields differ, only nonce matches - generic replacement

nodes.label: Classify as Speed-Up
nodes.description: Mark replacement type as tx_speedup

nodes.label: Classify as Cancel
nodes.description: Mark replacement type as tx_cancel

nodes.label: Classify as Replacement
nodes.description: Mark replacement type as tx_replacement

ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 10% is calculated as: new_gas_price >= old_gas_price * 1.10. It's unclear if this applies to maxFeePerGas, maxPriorityFeePerGas, or both for EIP-1559 transactions.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify behavior when multiple replacements occur in sequence
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each replacement triggers a new event relative to the immediately preceding transaction, not the original.

ambiguities.text: The 'from/to addresses' requirement for tx_cancel is ambiguous
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume tx_cancel requires from == to (self-send), meaning the user sends to their own address.

implicit_assumptions.description: The replacement transaction is submitted before the original is mined
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If original is already included in a block, replacement will fail and event semantics become unclear

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet/provider correctly tracks pending transactions and their nonces
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect tracking could lead to missed replacement events or false positives

implicit_assumptions.description: DApps trust the provider to emit accurate replacement events
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious provider could emit false events causing DApp to display incorrect transaction status

implicit_assumptions.description: Only the transaction sender can replace their own transaction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If attackers could replace others' transactions, this would enable transaction censorship or manipulation
